# Subscription page data for theme templates

What `theme/<section>.html` sees as `.` at the top of a section (and as `$`
anywhere in it). Lists (`[]…`) are what `range` may go over; inside, `.` is one
element. Texts in the reader's language are in `.L`.

- `.Lang` `i18n.Lang` — the reader's language: ru, en, zh, ar; .Lang.Dir is ltr or rtl
- `.L` — the page's texts in the reader's language: `.L.AWGDownload`, `.L.AWGHint`, `.L.AWGSite`, `.L.AWGTitle`, `.L.AccessCopy`, `.L.AccessHint`, `.L.AccessTitle`, `.L.AddBtn`, `.L.AddHint`, `.L.AddTitle`, `.L.AppLink`, `.L.AutoRenew`, `.L.Balance`, `.L.CancelConfirm`, `.L.CancelFailed`, `.L.CancelSub`, `.L.ChangeBtn`, `.L.ChangeConfirm`, `.L.ChangeHint`, `.L.ChangePlanNote`, `.L.ChangeTitle`, `.L.Colon`, `.L.Copied`, `.L.CopyLink`, `.L.Copy`, `.L.CurrentPlan`, `.L.DefaultBrand`, `.L.DeviceConfirm`, `.L.DeviceFailed`, `.L.DeviceNeverUse`, `.L.DeviceRemove`, `.L.DevicesEmpty`, `.L.DevicesHint`, `.L.Devices`, `.L.DownloadClash`, `.L.Error`, `.L.GetFree`, `.L.GreetingName`, `.L.Greeting`, `.L.History`, `.L.ManualImage`, `.L.NetworkError`, `.L.Offline`, `.L.Online`, `.L.OpenInApp`, `.L.OrderCreated`, `.L.OrderTitle`, `.L.PaidTitle`, `.L.PayBalance`, `.L.PayFailed`, `.L.PayMethod`, `.L.PayProcessing`, `.L.PayTitle`, `.L.Pay`, `.L.PickApp`, `.L.PlanChange`, `.L.PlanPick`, `.L.PlansTitle`, `.L.PromoApply`, `.L.PromoPlaceholder`, `.L.PromoTitle`, `.L.RefInvitees`, `.L.RefTitle`, `.L.RenewTitle`, `.L.Renew`, `.L.RotateConfirm`, `.L.RotateFailed`, `.L.RotateHint`, `.L.RotateLink`, `.L.RotateTitle`, `.L.ScanQR`, `.L.Share`, `.L.SingleConfigs`, `.L.TGBindHint`, `.L.TGBind`, `.L.TGChangeCopied`, `.L.TGChange`, `.L.TGProxyAdd`, `.L.TGProxyHint`, `.L.TGProxyTitle`, `.L.TabPay`, `.L.TabRef`, `.L.TabSub`, `.L.Title`, `.L.TopupAmount`, `.L.Topup`, `.L.TrafficUntil`, `.L.Traffic`, `.L.TurnHint`, `.L.TurnLink`, `.L.TurnManual`, `.L.TurnNoLink`, `.L.TurnPeer`, `.L.TurnTitle`, `.L.UserID`, `.L.WGHint`, `.L.WGSite`, `.L.WGTitle`, `.L.WzBack`, `.L.WzDone`, `.L.WzNext`, `.L.WzOpen`, `.L.WzOther`, `.L.WzStep1`, `.L.WzStep2`, `.L.WzStep3`
- `.UserID` `int64` — the user's id, to quote to support
- `.Name` `string` — the user's name, "" when they have none
- `.BrandName` `string` — panel display name (defaults to the stock RosPanel name)
- `.Brand` `string` — accent colour #rrggbb
- `.BrandDark` `string` — darker accent for hover/active states
- `.AccentFg` `string` — accent text colour adjusted for the surface
- `.OnBrand` `string` — label colour on an accent fill: white, or dark ink on a light accent
- `.SuccessFg` `string` — status text colours adjusted for the surface
- `.WarningFg` `string`
- `.DangerFg` `string`
- `.Ink` `string` — main text colour
- `.Muted` `string` — secondary text colour
- `.Bg` `string` — page background base
- `.Surface` `string` — card background
- `.Glow` `string` — what the top of the background fades from: white, or the surface on a dark theme
- `.Scheme` `string` — CSS color-scheme: light | dark, for the browser's own controls
- `.Dark` `pageColors (may be nil: use with)` — the dark theme, for a dark system
  - `.Brand` `string` — accent colour #rrggbb
  - `.BrandDark` `string` — darker accent for hover/active states
  - `.AccentFg` `string` — accent text colour adjusted for the surface
  - `.OnBrand` `string` — label colour on an accent fill: white, or dark ink on a light accent
  - `.SuccessFg` `string` — status text colours adjusted for the surface
  - `.WarningFg` `string`
  - `.DangerFg` `string`
  - `.Ink` `string` — main text colour
  - `.Muted` `string` — secondary text colour
  - `.Bg` `string` — page background base
  - `.Surface` `string` — card background
  - `.Glow` `string` — what the top of the background fades from: white, or the surface on a dark theme
  - `.Scheme` `string` — CSS color-scheme: light | dark, for the browser's own controls
- `.IsDefault` `bool` — true when the stock RosPanel name is in effect
- `.SubURL` `string` — the subscription link: what a client imports; {{.SubURL}}/qr.png is its QR
- `.Access` `Access` — the reader's access to this page, plugin blocks, notices and the survey
  - `.TGLink` `string` — the bot's link that binds this account to the Telegram that opens it
  - `.TGLinked` `bool` — already linked: the link moves it to another Telegram
  - `.TGWait` `string` — TGWait says when the Telegram may be changed instead of the link: it was moved more recently than the operator allows.
  - `.Legal` `[]LegalLink` — Legal are the operator's documents the page links to at its foot.
    - `.Title` `string`
    - `.URL` `string`
  - `.Blocks` `[]Block` — Blocks are what plugins add at the top of the page (internal/plugin).
    - `.Type` `string`
    - `.HTML` `template.HTML`
    - `.Label` `string`
    - `.URL` `string`
  - `.RotatePath` `string` — RotatePath is where the reader reissues their own link, "" when the operator does not allow it (Settings.SubSelfRotateHours); RotateWait says how often they may, in their language.
  - `.RotateWait` `string`
  - `.Notices` `[]Notice` — Notices are the status page's incidents and maintenance the reader should know of: going on now, or due soon. StatusURL links to the page, "" when it is off.
    - `.Kind` `string` — incident | maintenance
    - `.Label` `string` — the kind, worded
    - `.Title` `string`
    - `.Body` `string` — shortened
    - `.When` `string`
    - `.Scheduled` `string` — "planned", worded, for maintenance not begun yet; "" otherwise
    - `.NodeIDs` `[]int64` — NodeIDs are the servers it concerns (empty: the whole service), to match against the ones the reader can use. Not rendered.
  - `.StatusURL` `string`
  - `.StatusMore` `string` — StatusMore is the link's text and NoticesLabel the block's name, in the reader's language.
  - `.NoticesLabel` `string`
  - `.Churn` `Churn (may be nil: use with)` — Churn asks why the lapsed term was not renewed; nil when there is nothing to ask.
    - `.Path` `string`
    - `.Question` `string`
    - `.Reasons` `[]ChurnReason`
      - `.Key` `string`
      - `.Label` `string`
    - `.OtherPh` `string`
    - `.Send` `string`
    - `.Thanks` `string`
- `.Links` `[]protoLink` — one share link per protocol and server (shown when ShowConfigs)
  - `.Proto` `string`
  - `.URL` `string`
  - `.Open` `template.URL` — Open is the link as a button's href for a lane whose app opens the link itself rather than a subscription — TrustTunnel's tt:// — and "" for the rest.
- `.DeepLinks` `[]DeepLink` — "open in app" links, one per client, in the operator's order
  - `.Key` `string` — stable id the operator's order (model.Settings.SubApps) names
  - `.Label` `string`
  - `.Platform` `string`
  - `.Href` `template.URL`
- `.Wizard` `[]WizardPlatform` — Wizard is the connect wizard per platform; empty (every platform's client switched off) hides it.
  - `.Key` `string` — ios | android | windows | macos | linux | tv — what the page detects
  - `.Name` `string`
  - `.Links` `[]WizardLink`
    - `.Label` `string`
    - `.URL` `string`
  - `.AppIndex` `int` — AppIndex is the client's index in DeepLinks (the /app/<n> hand-off), Href its import link.
  - `.Href` `template.URL`
  - `.Hint1` `string`
  - `.Hint2` `string`
  - `.Hint3` `string`
  - `.AddLabel` `string`
- `.AWG` `[]awgCard` — AWG lists one card per server whose AmneziaWG lane the user may use: the config file to import and its QR.
  - `.Label` `string`
  - `.ConfURL` `string`
  - `.QRURL` `string`
- `.WG` `[]awgCard` — WG lists one card per plain WireGuard inbound the user may use: the config file to import and its QR.
  - `.Label` `string`
  - `.ConfURL` `string`
  - `.QRURL` `string`
- `.Turn` `[]turnCard` — Turn lists one card per WireGuard inbound behind a TURN relay the user may use.
  - `.Label` `string`
  - `.Peer` `string` — host:port of the relay
  - `.Link` `string` — call invite link, "" when the operator set none
  - `.ConfURL` `string`
  - `.Apps` `[]turnApp` — Apps are the client apps that import this lane from one link.
    - `.Name` `string` — the app's own name and platform; a brand, not translated
    - `.Link` `string`
    - `.Href` `template.URL`
    - `.AppLink` `string` — AppLink is the app's own page — its repository, where every one of these lives.
- `.Telegram` `[]tgProxyCard` — Telegram lists one card per server whose Telegram proxy the user may use.
  - `.Label` `string`
  - `.Link` `template.URL`
  - `.WebLink` `string`
  - `.QRURL` `string`
- `.StatusLabel` `string` — the subscription's state, worded: active, expired, disabled, limited
- `.StatusClass` `string` — the same as a colour: green, red, gray, orange
- `.Used` `string` — traffic used, formatted ("12 GB")
- `.Limit` `string` — the traffic limit, formatted; set when HasLimit
- `.HasLimit` `bool`
- `.UsedPct` `int` — used of the limit, 0-100
- `.ResetText` `string` — date the traffic quota next refills, e.g. "07.08.2026"
- `.HasReset` `bool`
- `.Expire` `string` — "until 23.12.2026", worded; set when HasExpire
- `.HasExpire` `bool`
- `.Online` `bool` — a client is connected now
- `.LastSeen` `string` — when one last was, "3 h ago"; "" if never
- `.Billing` `Billing` — plans, balance, promo codes, history and referrals; Billing.Show is false when selling is off
  - `.Show` `bool`
  - `.CurrentPlan` `string` — active plan name ("" = none / manual)
  - `.ExpireText` `string` — "until DD.MM.YYYY" for a paid expiry, else ""
  - `.Plans` `[]BillingPlan` — paid plans offered for purchase/renewal
    - `.ID` `int64`
    - `.Name` `string`
    - `.Label` `string` — price + period, e.g. "199 ₽ / 30 d"
    - `.Current` `bool` — the user's currently active plan
    - `.OldPrice` `string` — OldPrice is the price before a discount code, shown struck through ("" = none).
    - `.FromBalance` `bool` — FromBalance: the balance covers the price, so the button pays from it.
    - `.Promo` `string` — Promo names the discount code in the price ("Promo code X: −40 ₽"), "" = none.
    - `.Free` `bool` — Free: the discount takes the whole price — nothing is paid, from the balance or otherwise.
    - `.Button` `string` — Button is the pay button's label for the first option.
    - `.Options` `[]PlanOption` — Options are the terms on offer — one period, and each multi-period discount — empty when there is only one.
      - `.Periods` `int`
      - `.Label` `string` — "3 × 30 d — 537 ₽ (−10%)"
      - `.FromBalance` `bool`
      - `.Button` `string` — the pay button's label for this term
    - `.Devices` `[]DeviceOption` — Devices are the device counts a new plan can be bought with (the first is the plan's own), empty when it sells no extra devices.
      - `.Extra` `int` — devices beyond the plan's own
      - `.Label` `string` — "3 devices (+100 ₽ per period)"
  - `.Providers` `[]BillingPay` — Providers are the payment methods offered, in the order they are shown. Manual payment, when the operator has it on, is one of them under ManualPayKey.
    - `.Key` `string`
    - `.Label` `string`
  - `.Manual` `bool` — manual payment is offered
  - `.ManualOnly` `bool` — ManualOnly is manual payment with nothing else beside it. The page itself says nothing about it — the details and the picture arrive with the order the user opens — but a client rendering this block from the JSON can tell the two states apart. With a provider on the list, both are just methods to choose from.
  - `.Note` `string` — the operator's own manual-payment instructions
  - `.PayPath` `string` — POST target that starts a payment (<SubURL>/pay)
  - `.OrderPath` `string` — GET target that reports a pending provider payment (<SubURL>/order)
  - `.Locked` `bool` — Locked is true while a paid plan is active: only that plan (renewal) is shown, switching to another is blocked, and Cancelable offers cancellation instead.
  - `.Cancelable` `bool`
  - `.CancelPath` `string` — POST target that cancels the active plan (<SubURL>/cancel)
  - `.ExpireAt` `int64` — ExpireAt is the user's expiry as rendered; a purchase from the balance sends it back so a repeated click cannot buy a second period.
  - `.WalletPath` `string` — The wallet. WalletPath is the base the page posts its actions to (<WalletPath>/topup, /promo, /autorenew).
  - `.Wallet` `bool` — the balance block is shown
  - `.Topup` `bool` — the balance can be topped up (some payment method exists)
  - `.Balance` `string` — "150" or "19.90", in roubles
  - `.AutoRenew` `bool`
  - `.RenewSwitch` `bool` — RenewSwitch: the user's plan is one renewal can extend (paid, with a term).
  - `.RenewNote` `string` — RenewNote says what the renewal will do (hidden while renewal is off, and the switch shows it); RenewShort marks a balance that falls short of it.
  - `.RenewShort` `bool`
  - `.TopupMin` `int`
  - `.TopupMax` `int`
  - `.TopupHint` `string` — "from 100 ₽"
  - `.BonusDays` `string` — banked referral days, "" when none
  - `.Promo` `bool` — a promo field is offered
  - `.RefLink` `string` — the user's invite link, "" when the programme is off
  - `.RefHint` `string` — what one paying invitee earns
  - `.RefStats` `string` — "invited 3 · paid 1 · earned 40 ₽"
  - `.Invitees` `[]HistoryLine` — Invitees are the users who came by the link, newest first: when they joined, and what they earned the inviter (or whether they paid).
    - `.Title` `string` — "Balance top-up", "“Standard” plan"
    - `.When` `string`
    - `.Amount` `string` — signed: "+50 ₽", "−199 ₽"
    - `.In` `bool` — money in
    - `.Muted` `bool` — not an amount but a quiet status ("no payment yet")
  - `.InviteesMore` `string` — "and 12 more", "" when the list is whole
  - `.RefShare` `string` — a t.me/share link that hands RefLink to a chat
  - `.History` `[]HistoryLine` — History is what came into and went out of the user's money, newest first.
    - `.Title` `string` — "Balance top-up", "“Standard” plan"
    - `.When` `string`
    - `.Amount` `string` — signed: "+50 ₽", "−199 ₽"
    - `.In` `bool` — money in
    - `.Muted` `bool` — not an amount but a quiet status ("no payment yet")
  - `.Changes` `[]Extra` — Changes are the plans the user may move to now; Addons what they can add to the plan they hold.
    - `.Kind` `string`
    - `.PlanID` `int64`
    - `.N` `int`
    - `.Label` `string` — the whole offer in one line (the confirmation)
    - `.FromBalance` `bool`
    - `.Name` `string` — Name, Sub and Badge are the offer as a card: the plan or the add-on, its price per period or what it lasts, and what taking it costs or gives now. Up marks a change that is paid for.
    - `.Sub` `string`
    - `.Badge` `string`
    - `.Up` `bool`
    - `.Counts` `[]ExtraCount` — Counts are the numbers of devices on offer (a devices add-on): each with its price and button label.
      - `.N` `int`
      - `.Label` `string`
      - `.Button` `string`
      - `.FromBalance` `bool`
  - `.Addons` `[]Extra`
    - `.Kind` `string`
    - `.PlanID` `int64`
    - `.N` `int`
    - `.Label` `string` — the whole offer in one line (the confirmation)
    - `.FromBalance` `bool`
    - `.Name` `string` — Name, Sub and Badge are the offer as a card: the plan or the add-on, its price per period or what it lasts, and what taking it costs or gives now. Up marks a change that is paid for.
    - `.Sub` `string`
    - `.Badge` `string`
    - `.Up` `bool`
    - `.Counts` `[]ExtraCount` — Counts are the numbers of devices on offer (a devices add-on): each with its price and button label.
      - `.N` `int`
      - `.Label` `string`
      - `.Button` `string`
      - `.FromBalance` `bool`
  - `.Stamp` `int64` — Stamp is what an add-on bought from the balance is held to (core.PurchaseStamp).
- `.Devices` `Devices` — the devices bound to the subscription; Devices.Show is false when the operator does not show them
  - `.Show` `bool`
  - `.List` `[]DeviceRow`
    - `.HWID` `string`
    - `.Title` `string` — model, OS, or the raw id — whatever the client told us
    - `.Sub` `string` — OS + version, when known
    - `.LastSeen` `string` — humanised "3 h ago"
  - `.Count` `int`
  - `.Limit` `int` — 0 = unlimited
  - `.CountText` `string` — "2 / 3", or just the count when unlimited
  - `.UnbindPath` `string` — POST target that releases one device (<SubURL>/devices/unbind)
- `.ShowConfigs` `bool` — render the raw per-lane share links
- `.ShowDownload` `bool` — ShowDownload renders the "download the Clash config" button. Off when the operator requires an HWID: the button fetches this same URL from the browser, which sends no id and would be refused — an offer the page cannot keep.
- `.Asset string` `string` — Asset is a theme file's address, for a theme template: {{$.Asset "bg.webp"}}. "" for a name the theme does not have.
